Assignment conditions: Woven cotton blue-denim trousers; ordinary non-down branch. Excludes the specified compact-yarn branch. Verify fabric classification, not just a colour word in the title.

Product group: Men's trousers - other cotton / chinos / non-blue denim
Assignment conditions: Ordinary woven cotton trousers, other than blue denim, corduroy or medical-use garments; excludes specified compact yarns. Black/grey denim belongs here only if not classified as blue denim.
Ordinary woven cotton corduroy trousers; excludes down and specified compact-yarn branches. Not shorts or overalls.

Ordinary men's woven shorts classified as of cotton; not swimwear, knitted shorts, bib/brace overalls, recreational performance outerwear or the qualifying-down branch. Excludes the specified compact-yarn branch. Confirm actual fibre composition and garment construction; do not assign a trousers code to shorts.

Product group: Men's woven cotton denim bib-and-brace overalls
Assignment conditions: Ordinary men's woven cotton bib-and-brace overalls, including denim, with a bib and shoulder straps; not insulated for cold-weather protection, recreational performance outerwear or qualifying-down garments. Confirm cotton determines textile classification. Not trousers, shorts or full-body sleeved coveralls/boilersuits. Insulated cotton bib overalls require a different suffix.

Product group: Men's casual cotton shirt - multicolour, napped
Assignment conditions: Woven non-dress shirt with two or more colours in warp and/or filling, napped (e.g. qualifying check flannel). Excludes corduroy, specified compact yarns and certified folklore products.

Product group: Men's casual cotton shirt - multicolour, not napped
Assignment conditions: Woven non-dress shirt with two or more colours in warp and/or filling, not napped (e.g. qualifying chambray/denim/check). Excludes corduroy and specified compact yarns.
Ordinary woven non-dress cotton shirt outside the multicolour-yarn, corduroy and specified compact-yarn branches; excludes medical-use garments. A single-colour title alone is insufficient.
Ordinary woven non-dress cotton corduroy shirt; excludes specified compact-yarn branch. A corduroy overshirt classified as a jacket requires a jacket rule instead.
Woven shirt classified as of wool or fine animal hair; not knitted, a jacket, or a certified hand-loomed/folklore product.

Men's woven anorak/windbreaker or similar jacket, not suit-type, an overcoat, or padded sleeveless; ordinary non-performance branch; does not meet the specified down thresholds. Blue denim; not water resistant under Additional U.S. Note 2.

Men's woven anorak/windbreaker or similar jacket, not suit-type, an overcoat, or padded sleeveless; ordinary non-performance branch; does not meet the specified down thresholds. Other than blue denim or corduroy; not water resistant under Additional U.S. Note 2.
Woven cotton corduroy anorak/windbreaker or similar jacket; ordinary non-performance, non-down, non-water-resistant branch; not a suit-type jacket, overcoat or padded sleeveless jacket.

Product group: Men's cotton jacket - ordinary water resistant
Assignment conditions: Woven cotton anorak/windbreaker or similar jacket; ordinary non-performance, non-down branch; passes water-resistance rule WR. Not an overcoat or suit-type jacket.
Woven wool/fine-animal-hair anorak/windbreaker or similar jacket; ordinary non-recreational-performance branch; not a suit-type jacket, overcoat or padded sleeveless jacket.
Men's woven wool/fine-animal-hair overcoat, carcoat, cape, cloak or similar coat. Not a short jacket or suit-type jacket.

Men's woven anorak/windbreaker or similar jacket, not suit-type, an overcoat, or padded sleeveless; ordinary non-performance branch; does not meet the specified down thresholds. Of man-made fibres, below 36% wool/fine animal hair; not water resistant under rule WR.

Product group: Men's synthetic jacket - ordinary water resistant
Assignment conditions: Woven man-made-fibre anorak/windbreaker or similar jacket; ordinary non-performance branch, below 36% wool/fine animal hair; non-down branch and passes rule WR.

Product group: Men's synthetic performance jacket - water resistant
Assignment conditions: Meets rule RPO and water-resistance rule WR; below 36% wool/fine animal hair; non-down branch. Plastic treatment alone does not establish WR. Check coated-fabric heading 6210 before assignment.

Product group: Men's synthetic performance jacket - not water resistant
Assignment conditions: Meets rule RPO through qualifying plastic treatment but not rule WR; below 36% wool/fine animal hair; non-down, not padded sleeveless. Check whether coated-fabric heading 6210 applies first.

Product group: Men's cotton performance jacket - water resistant
Assignment conditions: Meets rules RPO and WR; non-down branch. Plastic treatment alone does not establish WR. Check coated-fabric heading 6210 before assignment.
Meets RPO but not WR; non-down, not padded sleeveless, not corduroy or blue denim. Check coated-fabric heading 6210 before assignment.
Woven man-made-fibre jacket meeting rules RPO and DOWN. A title saying down-filled is insufficient. Check coated-fabric heading 6210 first.
Woven cotton jacket meeting rules RPO and DOWN. A title saying down-filled is insufficient. Check coated-fabric heading 6210 first.

Product group: Men's woven cotton vest - ordinary unpadded, including denim
Assignment conditions: Men's/boys' ordinary unpadded woven cotton vest, including denim, canvas, duck, twill or corduroy. Cotton must determine the textile classification. Outside recreational-performance and protective/outerwear branches. Lining alone does not establish padding or change the heading; review insulated/protective styles individually. Not knitted or leather.

Product group: Men's woven synthetic vest - ordinary unpadded
Assignment conditions: Men's/boys' ordinary unpadded woven vest classified as of man-made fibres (e.g. nylon/polyester), containing less than 36% wool/fine animal hair. Outside recreational-performance and protective/outerwear branches; weather-protective sleeveless jackets can instead fall under 6201. Not knit/fleece. Material percentages and construction required.

Product group: Men's padded synthetic outerwear vest - no sleeve attachments
Assignment conditions: Woven outerwear padded sleeveless jacket classified as of man-made fibres; no attachments for sleeves. Ordinary non-RPO branch; does not meet rule DOWN. Not the ordinary unpadded vest provision. Check coated-fabric heading 6210 first where relevant.

Product group: Men's padded synthetic outerwear vest - sleeve attachments
Assignment conditions: Woven outerwear padded sleeveless jacket classified as of man-made fibres, with attachments for sleeves. Ordinary non-RPO branch; does not meet rule DOWN. Review separately if sleeves are supplied as a complete convertible garment; check heading 6210 where relevant.

Product group: Men's padded cotton outerwear vest - no sleeve attachments
Assignment conditions: Woven cotton outerwear padded sleeveless jacket, no sleeve attachments. Ordinary non-RPO branch; does not meet DOWN or WR. If rule WR is met, consider 6201307000 instead. Applies to qualifying denim and non-denim fabrics. Check coated-fabric heading 6210 where relevant.

Product group: Men's padded cotton outerwear vest - sleeve attachments
Assignment conditions: Woven cotton outerwear padded sleeveless jacket with attachments for sleeves. Ordinary non-RPO branch; does not meet DOWN or WR. If WR is met, consider 6201307000. Supplied sleeves can change treatment of the complete garment; check heading 6210 where relevant.

Woven outerwear padded sleeveless jacket classified as of wool/fine animal hair, ordinary non-RPO branch. Not an ordinary waistcoat, knitted sweater vest or vest classified as of man-made fibres. Confirm outer fabric and construction; check coated-fabric heading 6210 where relevant.

Product group: Men's down-filled synthetic outerwear vest - qualifying content
Assignment conditions: Woven outerwear sleeveless jacket classified as of man-made fibres, ordinary non-RPO branch, meeting rule DOWN by weight of the article. Do not assign from a down-filled title or fill-blend percentage alone. RPO down garments use a different branch; check heading 6210 where relevant.

Product group: Men's down-filled cotton outerwear vest - qualifying content
Assignment conditions: Woven cotton outerwear sleeveless jacket, ordinary non-RPO branch, meeting rule DOWN by weight of the article. Do not assign from a down-filled title or fill-blend percentage alone. RPO down garments use a different branch; check heading 6210 where relevant.

Product group: Men's knitted shirts - man-made fibres (including qualifying fleece shirts)
Assignment conditions: Men's knitted shirt classified as of man-made fibres, containing less than 23% by weight of wool or fine animal hair. Must meet heading 6105 shirt requirements, including sleeves, a full or partial opening from the neckline and the required stitch density. No pockets below the waist or tightening at the bottom. Confirm actual knit construction and stitch count; not an outerwear jacket or a cardigan/similar article of heading 6110. Fleece, snaps or a CPO name alone do not establish this code. IHSH-287-TUR remains unconfirmed.
Cotton knitted T-shirt outside the special plain-white and thermal-underwear branches; not a tank top, sweatshirt or woven shirt.

Product group: Men's/boys' cotton T-shirt - qualifying plain white
Assignment conditions: All white; short hemmed sleeves, hemmed bottom; crew/round neckline or qualifying mitred V-neck; no pockets, trim or embroidery. Do not assign solely because the title says white.
Knitted cotton garment classified as a sweatshirt; not the branch containing 36% or more flax. Verify hoodie construction is a sweatshirt, not another pullover/cardigan category.
Of wool, not cashmere. Meets Chapter 61 statistical sweater definition: essentially 9 or fewer stitches per 2 cm, or qualifying sweater construction whose surface stitches cannot be counted.
Knitted wool pullover outside the statistical sweater and non-sweater-vest branches; ordinarily more than 9 stitches per 2 cm. Cashmere has a different branch.
Ordinary non-knitted cotton textile full-crown headwear, not babies; excludes special fur-felt constructions, plaited-strip hats and visors without crown coverage.
Knitted cotton full-crown headwear, not babies or visors without crown coverage. Use actual material classification for blends.
Knitted/crocheted wool full-crown headwear, not babies or visors. Special felt constructions differ; cashmere/fine-animal-hair headwear needs separate checking.
Ordinary non-knitted wool textile full-crown headwear, not babies or visors; excludes special felt constructions classified in earlier branches.
Ordinary knitted cotton socks/hosiery without lace or net. Not graduated compression hosiery or separately classified pantyhose, tights or other special hosiery.

Ordinary knitted socks classified as of wool or fine animal hair. Confirm actual fibre composition for blends; not graduated compression hosiery, babies' hosiery, pantyhose/tights or other separately classified hosiery.

Composition by weight: 42% polypropylene, 35% cotton, 21% stretch nylon, 1% stretch polyester, 1% spandex. Synthetic fibres total 65%; cotton 35%; no wool. Ordinary knitted socks without lace/net, graduated compression or applied soles; not babies' hosiery or other separately classified hosiery. Based on the supplied composition, not a physical-sample ruling.

Product group: Men's heritage / engineer boots - welt, non-leather sole
Assignment conditions: Leather uppers other than pigskin; covers ankle; legal welt construction; outer sole rubber, plastics or composition leather. Non-work branch; no protective metal toe-cap. Pull-on engineer boots may qualify.

Ankle-covering leather-upper welt footwear with rubber/plastic outer sole, no protective metal toe-cap; occupational design plus workplace-hazard protection. Slip-on engineer boots do not qualify. Heritage/work styling alone is insufficient.
Ankle-covering non-work welt footwear with pigskin uppers and rubber/plastics/composition-leather outer sole; no protective metal toe-cap.

Product group: Men's boots - welt, leather outer sole
Assignment conditions: Ankle-covering welt footwear with leather outer sole and leather uppers other than pigskin; no protective metal toe-cap. Do not infer outer-sole material from leather midsole or heel.
Ankle-covering non-welt, non-athletic, non-work footwear; rubber/plastics/composition-leather outer sole and non-pigskin leather upper; no protective metal toe-cap.

Textile upper and rubber/plastic outer sole; qualifying athletic construction; customs value over USD12/pair; other branch, not special sports footwear or otherwise excluded. Casual marketing does not make athletic construction non-athletic.

Textile upper, rubber/plastic outer sole, non-athletic; customs value over USD12/pair; qualifying closed/fastened footwear or qualifying slip-ons with foxing(-like) band. Check protective, slipper and textile-contact-sole branches before assignment.

Product group: Men's textile slip-ons - vegetable fibre, low rubber/plastic
Assignment conditions: Qualifying slip-on/open footwear outside the foxing-band exception; vegetable-fibre upper; below 10% rubber/plastics by weight; not house slippers or footwear of 64041920. Confirm full Chapter 64 exclusions.

Product group: Men's textile slip-ons - other fibre, low rubber/plastic
Assignment conditions: Qualifying slip-on/open footwear outside the foxing-band exception; non-vegetable textile upper; below 10% rubber/plastics by weight; not house slippers or footwear of 64041920. Confirm full Chapter 64 exclusions.

Product group: Men's textile slip-ons - other, higher rubber/plastic
Assignment conditions: Qualifying slip-on/open footwear outside the foxing-band exception; at least 10% rubber/plastics by weight; not house slippers; excludes earlier branches for specified textile-contact outer soles and footwear of 64041920.
Shoelaces of leather or composition leather. Textile and cordage laces use different headings.
Finished cotton fabric footwear lacings. Certain cordage constructions instead fall under 5609; confirm construction, not just fibre content.
Finished non-cotton fabric footwear lacings, e.g. qualifying polyester/nylon lacings. Certain cordage constructions instead fall under 5609.
Only footwear lacings classified as articles of cotton yarn/twine/cordage, rather than made-up fabric lacings. Construction review required; not an automatic alternative to 6307905010.
Only footwear lacings classified as articles of man-made-fibre yarn/twine/cordage, rather than made-up fabric lacings. Construction review required.
Men's/boys' leather or composition-leather coat/jacket; not an anorak and not reptile leather. Shirt-jackets require a garment-type decision.
Leather/composition-leather apparel classified as an anorak; not reptile leather. Do not use the ordinary leather-jacket suffix.
Men's/boys' leather/composition-leather apparel other than coats/jackets; not reptile leather. A leather overshirt classified as a jacket uses the jacket branch.
Leather/composition-leather belts or bandoliers, with or without buckles. Buckles sold separately require separate classification.
Other leather/composition-leather clothing accessories, not reptile leather. Not separately classified belts, gloves, apparel, wallets or bags.

Residual other leather/composition-leather articles, not reptile leather, only after ruling out a more specific provision. Leather keyrings require checking the whole article and any metal component; not a universal keyring rule.
Handbag with man-made-fibre textile outer surface, not wholly or partly of braid; not a backpack, travel/sports bag or plastic-sheet-surface bag.
Backpack within travel/sports/similar-bag provision, with man-made-fibre textile outer surface. Coating can affect which material constitutes the outer surface.

Product group: Polyester / nylon travel / sports / similar bag
Assignment conditions: Other travel/sports/similar bag with man-made-fibre textile outer surface; not a backpack, handbag or insulated food/beverage bag.

Product group: Cotton canvas tote / travel / similar bag
Assignment conditions: Travel/sports/similar bag with cotton vegetable-fibre textile outer surface, not pile or tufted construction; not a handbag or packing sack. Confirm use and outer surface.
Cotton sack/bag of a kind used for packing goods; not a reusable travel/shopping tote classified in 4202.
Pocket/handbag-type wallet with leather/composition-leather outer surface, not reptile leather. A leather lining does not establish the outer-surface material.
Pocket/handbag-type wallet with man-made-fibre textile outer surface, not wholly or partly of braid and not plastic sheeting.

Assignment conditions: Finished silver jewellery valued over USD18 per dozen pieces/parts; excludes chain stock suitable for jewellery manufacture. Precious-metal-clad base metal is a different branch.

Section: 06 Jewellery, small textiles and other products
Assignment conditions: Other silver jewellery valued not over USD18 per dozen pieces/parts; excludes chain stock suitable for jewellery manufacture.

Section: 06 Jewellery, small textiles and other products
Product group: Silver chain stock for jewellery manufacture
Assignment conditions: Qualifying rope/curb/cable/chain articles produced in continuous lengths, suitable for jewellery manufacture. Chain sold by length alone is insufficient; finished jewellery requires separate consideration.

Section: 06 Jewellery, small textiles and other products
Assignment conditions: Ordinary finished base-metal imitation jewellery; not precious-metal-clad base metal, cufflinks/studs, devotional articles, qualifying manufacturing chain stock or low-value toy jewellery.

Section: 06 Jewellery, small textiles and other products
Assignment conditions: Hemmed cotton handkerchief-type article, square/approximately square with no side over 60cm; no lace or embroidery. Material, shape and dimensions must be confirmed.

Section: 06 Jewellery, small textiles and other products
Assignment conditions: Cotton shawl/scarf or similar article; includes square/approximately square scarf-type articles with a side over 60cm. Not a knitted scarf or handkerchief-type article.

Section: 06 Jewellery, small textiles and other products
Assignment conditions: Non-embroidered woven cotton badge/patch or similar article in the other-than-labels branch. Woven labels have different suffixes; leather patches differ.

Section: 06 Jewellery, small textiles and other products
Assignment conditions: Non-embroidered woven man-made-fibre badge/patch or similar article, other than labels. Use actual material classification.

Section: 06 Jewellery, small textiles and other products
Product group: Embroidered patch - cotton, not over 200 g/m2
Assignment conditions: Cotton embroidery in the piece, strips or motifs, including qualifying patches; weight not over 200g/m2. Not embroidery without visible ground. Confirm material classification and fabric weight.

Section: 06 Jewellery, small textiles and other products
Assignment conditions: Cotton embroidery in the piece, strips or motifs; weight over 200g/m2. Not embroidery without visible ground. Confirm material classification and weight.

Section: 06 Jewellery, small textiles and other products
Assignment conditions: Man-made-fibre embroidered badge, emblem or motif. Not a woven-only patch, label or embroidery without visible ground.

Section: 06 Jewellery, small textiles and other products
Assignment conditions: Household porcelain/china mug, not bone china, not available in the specified tableware sets and not restaurant/hotel ware. Stoneware/earthenware mugs require another heading.

Section: 06 Jewellery, small textiles and other products
Assignment conditions: Polishes, creams and similar preparations for footwear or leather. Not all shoe-care products: brushes, detergents/cleaners and other preparations require separate classification.

Section: 06 Jewellery, small textiles and other products
Product group: Wool blankets / travelling rugs - length up to 3 metres
Assignment conditions: Non-electric blanket or travelling rug classified as of wool or fine animal hair. Length not over 3 metres, including exactly 3 metres. Confirm actual fibre composition and textile-mixture rules for blends. Not a filled quilt, duvet, comforter, electric blanket or floor rug. Free is the general base rate only; origin-dependent duties and fees may still apply.

Section: 06 Jewellery, small textiles and other products
Product group: Wool blankets / travelling rugs - length over 3 metres
Assignment conditions: Non-electric blanket or travelling rug classified as of wool or fine animal hair. Length over 3 metres. Confirm actual fibre composition and textile-mixture rules for blends. Not a filled quilt, duvet, comforter, electric blanket or floor rug. Free is the general base rate only; origin-dependent duties and fees may still apply.
